fusions.name: Drawn Off
fusions.desc: Sends a blotting sheet into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Soiled Blotters
fusions.desc: Scatters used blotting sheets across a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Apothecary's Script
fusions.desc: Writes out a remedy that removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
